verdict.rationale: AFK documents first-party connections to a handful of named ops tools (Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe, "and more") that it can query and act on from one surface, with scoped OAuth. Nothing shows a catalog anywhere near thousands of apps. Missing for 10: evidence of an integration catalog at the scale of thousands of apps, an explicit statement that integrations are vendor-maintained, a published connector list, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations

citations.quote: Query and act across Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe, and more from a single surface.
Start a process, and Ultrametric coordinates the steps across your tools.
Scoped OAuth tokens, encrypted secrets, automatic key rotation, and full audit logs.
